item.title: Declare is a UI language for you and your AI
item.description: Designed from the ground up for interfaces that act and move like the best native apps, in a few hundred lines your AI can write and its compiler can check. item.title: NariQ: BF16-level Qwen3.8-27B in a 10 GB file
item.description: We built NariQ: 3-bit-or-lower compact packing of Qwen3.8-27B that retain near-BF16 quality across self-directed tasks, math, multilingual reasoning, and image understanding. Benchmarks (BF16 / 3-bit / 2.5-bit / 2-bit): - DeepSWE: 39.8 / 41.0 / 41.9 / 28.6 - Terminal-Bench 2.1: 62.6 / 63.8 / 60.2 / 52.4 - AIME 25+26: 97.7 / 98.3 / 96.5 / 86.0 - MSGM: 94.0 / 93.1 / 91.8 / 90.6 - RealWorldQA: 82.4 / 82.4 / 81.3 / 80.9 Decode speed is comparable to other quants on an RTX. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://huggingface.co/nari-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF
